label: Outcomes and prognostic factors in patients with systemic mastocytosis and an associated myeloid neoplasm: an international ECNM registry study.
summary: Systemic mastocytosis (SM) is a spectrum of hematologic disorders characterized by accumulation of atypical mast cells (MCs) in extracutaneous organs. SM with an associated hematologic neoplasm (SM-AHN), the most frequent subtype of advanced SM, is predominantly associated with myeloid neoplasms, consistent with shared clonal architecture.
